what: Reference values for run_smoke.sh. Measured on 15 Nov 2026 with ngspice-42 and SKY130A from open_pdks 1689ac3f2dc763876eaf967227c7dfe831b031ae (the commit IIC-OSIC-TOOLS 2026.10 pins), fetched with ciel. Ranges allow for another ngspice version (the container has ngspice-47) and, for the Monte Carlo lines, for a different random-number sequence: the std of 40 samples has a relative sampling spread of about 11 %, so the range is about +-35 %; the mean of 40 samples of a zero-mean offset has a spread of std/sqrt(40) = 1.5 mV, so the range is +-4 of those.
